ideas.what: Testing straight-line realisability of a pseudo-line configuration by normalising a frame (two pairs of lines forming a square of side 2) and turning the order of crossings into linear inequalities on segment lengths
ideas.modern_name: stretchability / realisability of pseudoline arrangements (oriented matroid realisation)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Levi (1926), Ringel (1956), Goodman–Pollack (1980s), Mnëv (1988) for complexity

ideas.what: Elementary inequality chain a+a' ≤ 2, a'+b > 2 ⇒ b > a
ideas.modern_name: linear inequality elimination in a coordinate realisation

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine hand computation checking whether a small pseudo-line configuration can be realised by straight lines. Its only interest is documenting that Grothendieck actually worked hands-on on stretchability; no new result or connection is on the page.
